summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Alpha Tau Medical Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting a press release about an abstract acceptance for a pancreatic cancer study presentation at an upcoming medical conference. The filing contains no special-situations corporate event—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. It is a standard current report of a clinical milestone disclosure, not a special situation.
